spec.description: Live RWA basis pilot: reset-immune perp PnL and funding attribution, per-name positions and entry prices, current basis, fills and data health. Fixed to the pilot env/account.

panels.description: Perp leg (net, funding included) + IB hedge leg, both over the dashboard time range. This is the whole basis book. The two legs are queried from different InfluxDB instances and summed by the panel; the breakdown is to the right.

targets.query: SELECT sum(net) AS all_in FROM (SELECT last("pnl") - first("pnl") AS net, last("gross_pnl") - first("gross_pnl") AS gross FROM "strategy_pnl_summary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "strategy" =~ /RwaBasisQuoter/ AND "base_currency" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ GROUP BY "base_currency", "strategy", "mimid_start_time")

SELECT sum("d") AS all_in FROM (SELECT last("unrealized_pnl") - first("unrealized_pnl") AS "d" FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ GROUP BY "symbol")

panels.title: All-in PnL (selected range)

panels.description: Both legs follow the time picker. Perp leg is the sum of per-session (last - first) net PnL from strategy_pnl_summary, so graph restarts cannot reset it, and it already includes funding. IB hedge leg is the change in unrealised PnL of the stock hedges over the range. These two add up to the all-in figure.

targets.query: SELECT sum(net) AS perp_net, sum(gross) AS perp_gross FROM (SELECT last("pnl") - first("pnl") AS net, last("gross_pnl") - first("gross_pnl") AS gross FROM "strategy_pnl_summary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "strategy" =~ /RwaBasisQuoter/ AND "base_currency" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ GROUP BY "base_currency", "strategy", "mimid_start_time")

SELECT sum("d") AS ib_upnl FROM (SELECT last("unrealized_pnl") - first("unrealized_pnl") AS "d" FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ GROUP BY "symbol")

panels.title: PnL by leg

panels.description: Net and gross perp notional using the position poller's latest entry/hedge mark.

targets.query: SELECT sum("n") FROM (SELECT last("notional") AS "n" FROM "rwa_position" WHERE time > now() - 10m AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp_total' GROUP BY "symbol")

SELECT sum("g") FROM (SELECT abs(last("notional")) AS "g" FROM "rwa_position" WHERE time > now() - 10m AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp_total' GROUP BY "symbol")

panels.title: Perp inventory

panels.description: Fees over the selected range. Positive values are costs; negative perp values are rebates.

targets.query: SELECT sum("fee") FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp'

SELECT sum("fee") FROM "ib_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/

panels.title: Execution fees

panels.description: Fill count over the selected range.

targets.query: SELECT count("last_qty") FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp'

SELECT count("qty") FROM "ib_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/

panels.title: Fills

panels.description: Is this book making money? All-in should grind up. Restarts cannot leak in because increments are computed inside each graph session; a brand-new session can drop at most its first bucket.

targets.query: SELECT sum("d") AS perp_bucket FROM (SELECT difference(last("pnl")) AS "d" FROM "strategy_pnl_summary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "strategy" =~ /RwaBasisQuoter/ AND "base_currency" =~ /^(AAPL|AMZN|MSFT|NVDA|TSLA)$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "strategy", "mimid_start_time" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

SELECT sum("d") AS ib_bucket FROM (SELECT difference(last("unrealized_pnl")) AS "d" FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMZN|MSFT|NVDA|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

panels.title: Capture PnL — cumulative over selected range

panels.description: Same accounting as the headline, scoped to this book's names.

targets.query: SELECT sum(net) AS perp_net, sum(gross) AS perp_gross FROM (SELECT last("pnl") - first("pnl") AS net, last("gross_pnl") - first("gross_pnl") AS gross FROM "strategy_pnl_summary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "strategy" =~ /RwaBasisQuoter/ AND "base_currency" =~ /^(AAPL|AMZN|MSFT|NVDA|TSLA)$/ GROUP BY "base_currency", "strategy", "mimid_start_time")

SELECT sum("d") AS ib_upnl FROM (SELECT last("unrealized_pnl") - first("unrealized_pnl") AS "d" FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMZN|MSFT|NVDA|TSLA)$/ GROUP BY "symbol")

panels.title: Capture — PnL over range

panels.description: Traded notional per hour on each leg. The two should track each other; a persistent gap is unhedged flow. NB rwa_fill drops same-millisecond partial fills, so perp bars can under-report.

targets.query: SELECT sum("notional") FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMZN|MSFT|NVDA|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp' GROUP BY time(1h) fill(0)

SELECT sum("notional") FROM "ib_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMZN|MSFT|NVDA|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ GROUP BY time(1h) fill(0)

panels.title: Capture volume

panels.description: POSITIVE adverse slip = the hedge bought above / sold below the perp fill: edge given back. Negative = the hedge improved on the perp price. Per bucket: VWAP = sum(notional)/sum(qty) per leg; direction is the net perp side. Footer sums Slip notional: divide by summed Volume for the vol-weighted average. Filter the dashboard to one symbol for exact per-name numbers - buckets where several names fill together mix their VWAPs. A hedge completing after the 2m boundary straddles two buckets and shows as two half-legs.

targets.query: SELECT sum("notional") AS hedge_notional FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMZN|MSFT|NVDA|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'hedge' GROUP BY time(2m) fill(none)

SELECT sum("last_qty") AS hedge_qty FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMZN|MSFT|NVDA|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'hedge' GROUP BY time(2m) fill(none)

SELECT sum("notional") AS perp_notional FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMZN|MSFT|NVDA|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp' GROUP BY time(2m) fill(none)

SELECT sum("last_qty") AS perp_qty FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMZN|MSFT|NVDA|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp' GROUP BY time(2m) fill(none)

SELECT sum("signed_qty") AS perp_signed FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMZN|MSFT|NVDA|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp' GROUP BY time(2m) fill(none)

panels.title: Capture hedge slippage (2m buckets)

panels.description: Every recorded fill on both legs, newest first. A perp row with no IB row shortly after it is an unhedged fill. Caveat: rwa_fill drops partial fills sharing a millisecond timestamp (int_fill_id is a field, not a tag), so a sweep can appear smaller than it was - MSFT 4 Aug is the known example.

targets.query: SELECT "last_qty" AS "perp_qty", "price" AS "fill_px", "fee" AS "fee" FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMZN|MSFT|NVDA|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp' GROUP BY "symbol", "direction"

SELECT "qty" AS "ib_qty", "price" AS "fill_px", "fee" AS "fee" FROM "ib_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMZN|MSFT|NVDA|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ GROUP BY "symbol", "side"

panels.title: Capture fill ledger

panels.description: Is this book making money? All-in should grind up. Restarts cannot leak in because increments are computed inside each graph session; a brand-new session can drop at most its first bucket. The funding line is the commission-bucket proxy (net - gross); on 5 Aug it measured ~40x the venue's actual funding on spot checks, so treat it as directional only until the userFunding poller replaces it.

targets.query: SELECT sum("d") AS perp_bucket FROM (SELECT difference(last("pnl")) AS "d" FROM "strategy_pnl_summary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "strategy" =~ /RwaBasisQuoter/ AND "base_currency" =~ /^(AMAT|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSTR|MU|NBIS|SNDK)$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "strategy", "mimid_start_time" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

SELECT sum("d") AS ib_bucket FROM (SELECT difference(last("unrealized_pnl")) AS "d" FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AMAT|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSTR|MU|NBIS|SNDK)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

SELECT sum("dn") - sum("dg") AS ff_bucket FROM (SELECT difference(last("pnl")) AS "dn", difference(last("gross_pnl")) AS "dg" FROM "strategy_pnl_summary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "strategy" =~ /RwaBasisQuoter/ AND "base_currency" =~ /^(AMAT|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSTR|MU|NBIS|SNDK)$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "strategy", "mimid_start_time" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

panels.title: Carry PnL — cumulative over selected range

panels.description: Same accounting as the headline, scoped to this book's names.

targets.query: SELECT sum(net) AS perp_net, sum(gross) AS perp_gross FROM (SELECT last("pnl") - first("pnl") AS net, last("gross_pnl") - first("gross_pnl") AS gross FROM "strategy_pnl_summary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "strategy" =~ /RwaBasisQuoter/ AND "base_currency" =~ /^(AMAT|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSTR|MU|NBIS|SNDK)$/ GROUP BY "base_currency", "strategy", "mimid_start_time")

SELECT sum("d") AS ib_upnl FROM (SELECT last("unrealized_pnl") - first("unrealized_pnl") AS "d" FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AMAT|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSTR|MU|NBIS|SNDK)$/ GROUP BY "symbol")

panels.description: Traded notional per hour on each leg. The two should track each other; a persistent gap is unhedged flow. NB rwa_fill drops same-millisecond partial fills, so perp bars can under-report.

targets.query: SELECT sum("notional") FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AMAT|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSTR|MU|NBIS|SNDK)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp' GROUP BY time(1h) fill(0)

SELECT sum("notional") FROM "ib_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AMAT|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSTR|MU|NBIS|SNDK)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ GROUP BY time(1h) fill(0)

SELECT sum("last_qty") AS hedge_qty FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AMAT|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSTR|MU|NBIS|SNDK)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'hedge' GROUP BY time(2m) fill(none)

SELECT sum("last_qty") AS perp_qty FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AMAT|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSTR|MU|NBIS|SNDK)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp' GROUP BY time(2m) fill(none)

Caveat: rwa_fill drops partial fills sharing a millisecond timestamp (int_fill_id is a field, not a tag), so a sweep can appear smaller than it was - MSFT 4 Aug is the known example.

targets.query: SELECT "last_qty" AS "perp_qty", "price" AS "fill_px", "fee" AS "fee" FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AMAT|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSTR|MU|NBIS|SNDK)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp' GROUP BY "symbol", "direction"

panels.title: Carry fill ledger

panels.description: Perp entry is the quantity-weighted VWAP for the side of the current position (sell VWAP for a short, buy VWAP for a long); opposite-side fills are treated as closes. Entry edge is pre-fee; IB average cost includes IB commission. Every column here comes from the rwa_strategies datasource, which is keyed by symbol. Perp PnL is in its own panel to the right because its datasource is keyed by placement instead.

targets.query: SELECT last("risk_qty") AS "perp_qty" FROM "rwa_position" WHERE time > now() - 10m AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp_total' GROUP BY "symbol"

SELECT sum("notional") / sum("last_qty") AS "perp_sell_vwap", sum("last_qty") AS "perp_sell_qty" FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE time > now() - 30d AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp' AND "direction" = 'SELL' GROUP BY "symbol"

SELECT sum("notional") / sum("last_qty") AS "perp_buy_vwap", sum("last_qty") AS "perp_buy_qty" FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE time > now() - 30d AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp' AND "direction" = 'BUY' GROUP BY "symbol"

SELECT sum("fee") AS "perp_fee" FROM "rwa_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ AND "leg_type" = 'perp' GROUP BY "symbol"

SELECT last("qty") AS "ib_qty", last("avg_cost") AS "ib_avg_entry" FROM "ib_position" WHERE time > now() - 10m AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ GROUP BY "symbol"

SELECT last("market_value") AS "ib_market_value", last("market_price") AS "stock_mark" FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE time > now() - 10m AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ GROUP BY "symbol"

SELECT last("unrealized_pnl") - first("unrealized_pnl") AS "ib_total_pnl" FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ GROUP BY "symbol"

SELECT sum("fee") AS "ib_fee" FROM "ib_fill" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ GROUP BY "symbol"

panels.title: Current book by name

panels.description: Sum over graph sessions of (last - first) net PnL per name within the selected range, so restarts cannot reset it. Funding + fees is net minus gross: funding received less exchange fees.

targets.query: SELECT sum(net) AS perp_net, sum(gross) AS perp_gross FROM (SELECT last("pnl") - first("pnl") AS net, last("gross_pnl") - first("gross_pnl") AS gross FROM "strategy_pnl_summary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "strategy" =~ /RwaBasisQuoter/ AND "base_currency" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ GROUP BY "base_currency", "strategy", "mimid_start_time") GROUP BY "base_currency"

panels.title: Perp PnL by name (incl. funding)

panels.description: StrategySignal diagnostic only. It includes funding and venue fees but resets with the graph. The headline and table instead sum strategy_pnl_summary by mimid_start_time, so no manual restart offsets are needed.

targets.query: SELECT last("pnl") FROM "StrategySignal" WHERE $timeFilter AND "strategy" =~ /RwaBasisQuoter/ AND "strategy" =~ /(${symbol:regex})USD/ GROUP BY time(5m), "strategy" fill(previous)

panels.title: Perp PnL by name — raw graph sessions

panels.description: IB unrealized PnL from commission-adjusted average cost.

targets.query: SELECT last("unrealized_pnl") FROM "ib_position_pnl" WHERE $timeFilter AND "env" = 'pilot' AND "account" = 'U25650461' AND "symbol" =~ /^(AAPL|AMAT|AMZN|BABA|EBAY|EWY|GOOGL|HOOD|INTC|META|MRVL|MSFT|MSTR|MU|NBIS|NVDA|SNDK|TSLA)$/ AND "symbol" =~ /^(${symbol:regex})$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "symbol" fill(previous)

panels.title: IB uPnL by name

panels.title: Pipeline health

content:
**All-in** = reset-immune net perp PnL + IB leg PnL. Each leg is aggregated to a single row by its own InfluxDB, then the two rows are stacked and added by the panel. Per-name attribution is split across two tables for the same reason it cannot be one table: the perp source is keyed by placement and the IB source by symbol, so there is no join key to combine them row-wise.

**Perp PnL incl funding** = per graph session, `last(pnl) - first(pnl)` from `strategy_pnl_summary`, summed over sessions. Sessions start at zero, so restarts cannot reset the total and no offset table is needed.

**Funding + fees** = `perp net - perp gross`, which is Mimid's commission bucket. Funding payouts and exchange fees are both booked there and published data does not separate them, so this is funding received net of perp execution fees, not funding alone.

**IB PnL** = the change in IB's own unrealised PnL across the selected range. Needing no market-value baseline is what makes it window-safe, but it does exclude PnL realised by closing a hedge inside the range; `realized_pnl` is constant across the book today, so nothing is currently missing.

**Time range** drives PnL, fills and fees. Entry VWAP and average cost describe the position open right now, so they ignore the picker.

**Book rows** answer 'are we making money and why': the cumulative graph starts at zero at the left edge of the range (so old testing PnL is excluded by picking a window), the slippage table shows edge kept vs given back per hedge, and the fill ledger shows every recorded print. Two data caveats: rwa_fill drops same-millisecond partial fills, and the Carry funding line is a proxy that spot-checked ~40x actual venue funding - trust it for direction only until the userFunding poller lands.
